g.title: s2
g.text: DeBERTa-v3 detector → r_q ; R ← noisy-OR(R, r_q)

g.title: s4
g.text: θ = 0.50 (0.30 if R > 0.45) → drop dirty passages

g.title: s5
g.text: query echo q_i + coordination c_i (cos > 0.85, ROUGE-L > 0.25)
r_i ≥ 0.5 → drop; near-duplicates → one source group

g.title: s6
g.text: answer voting by source group · dropped-cluster veto

g.title: s7
g.text: Presidio NER + DLP regex (Luhn) → mask, never refuse
